class.name: CubismMotionHandle
class.brief_description: Retained status and deferred events for one native motion playback.
class.description: Contains no native model pointer and remains readable after model disposal. Rejected plays are already terminal with FAILED and an error code. Check [method is_finished] before awaiting [signal finished]. Accepted plays terminate once; loops emit boundaries without completing. Stopped and interrupted plays become terminal while their native influence may still fade.

method.name: get_id
method.description: Unique instance ID of this handle.

method.name: is_finished
method.description: Whether the handle is terminal, including immediate rejection.

method.name: get_reason
method.description: Terminal reason, or NONE during playback.

method.name: get_error
method.description: Redot error code. Non-error termination retains OK.

method.name: get_loop_count
method.description: Completed loop boundaries. The pinned R5 loop period includes one source frame.

method.name: get_elapsed_seconds
method.description: Elapsed motion time after speed scaling. One-shot time is clamped to native duration; loop time is cumulative.

signal.name: finished
signal.description: Deferred terminal transition, once for an accepted play.
